testimonials.quote: Best steak I've had in Manila. The sizzle when it hit the table said it all.
testimonials.name: Maria L.

testimonials.quote: The truffle fettuccine is worth the trip alone — and the Old Fashioned might be the best in the city.
testimonials.name: Daniel R.

testimonials.quote: Warm, elegant, and the wagyu burger genuinely stopped our conversation. We booked our next visit before we even left.
testimonials.name: Angela T.
